description.text: International Economics and Trade is an interdisciplinary subject that studies cross-border transactions of goods and services, international capital flows, and the coordination of economic policies, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, management, law, and statistics. This major focuses on global resource allocation, international trade rules, and cross-border business operations, aiming to cultivate compound talents with an international perspective and practical abilities, and to meet the demands of fields such as cross-border trade, international investment, and cross-border e-commerce in the context of globalization.

duration.text: The International economics and trade at Shenyang Agricultural University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. One original copy and one photocopy of Application Form of Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students (see the attachment)2. Notarized certificate of highest degree and transcripts. A certificate of enrollment or a certificate of employment should also be submitted if applicants have been officially employed for a job. Documents that are formulated neither in Chinese of English should be enclosed with a notarized Chinese or English version upon submission.3. One original copy and photocopy of Foreigners Physical Examination Report4. Study and Research Plan in China (no less than 1000 words)5. Recommendation letters from 2 professors or associate professors of the previous school.

requirements.text: No criminal record, high school graduate, physically and mentally healthy
